parameters.content:
## 🌐 Workflow 8 — CareerPulse: OAuth Job Hunter Web App, Split-Screen Studio & Career Academy

### 1. Public Career & Interview Academy (`GET /webhook/job-dashboard`)
- **Career & Analytics Blog**, **18+ Interview-Ready Q&A Vault**, **6-Pillar Interview Preparation Blueprint & Interactive Checklist**, and **30-60-90 Day Job Success Playbook**.

### 2. OAuth Protected Owner Command Center (`POST /webhook/job-dashboard-api`)
- **Desktop Split-Screen Studio**: Job Details, Control Buttons & Section Rewriter on the Left + Embedded Google Drive PDF & Live A4 Document Preview on the Right (`📄 Custom Resume` ↔ `✉️ Cover Letter` ↔ `🎓 Master Resume`).
- **Graphical Funnel & Analytics**, **Interactive Master Table**, **`Generate new jobs` (Non-Collision Batch 25)**, **LinkedIn Queue + `li_at` Cookie**, **Friends & HR Network**, and **Learned Rules & Portals Vault**.

ALTER TABLE linkedin_network_contacts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS messages_json TEXT DEFAULT '[]'; ALTER TABLE linkedin_network_contacts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS conversation_urn TEXT DEFAULT ''; UPDATE learned_rules SET triggered_by_comment = CASE WHEN triggered_by_comment IS NULL OR triggered_by_comment = 'Web App Manual Rule' THEN rule_instruction ELSE triggered_by_comment END, rule_instruction = 'SUMMARY — NO STATISTICS OR NUMERICAL METRICS DIRECTIVE: NEVER include percentages, numbers, record volumes, or quantitative metrics (such as "1M+ monthly records", "40%", "25%–30%", "84%", or "15+ launches") in the Summary section; reserve all numerical metrics strictly for the Experience section bullets. Instead, write a qualitative 3-sentence Summary grounded in Sumanto''s past experience across enterprise SQL/Python analytics, Tableau BI reporting, workflow automation, and stakeholder consulting, tailored directly to the current Job Description.' WHERE id = 686 OR rule_instruction ILIKE 'Don''t use statistics%' OR rule_instruction ILIKE '%Proven track record of analyzing 1M+%'; UPDATE learned_rules SET rule_instruction = 'SUMMARY — 80/20 GROUNDED EXPERIENCE & JD ALIGNMENT DIRECTIVE: Always open the Summary with the grounded title "Senior Data & Business Analyst" (never copy the target job title verbatim). Anchor 80% of the Summary in a qualitative synthesis of Sumanto''s real experience across enterprise data analytics, BI dashboard automation, operational process governance, and commercial stakeholder strategy (strictly WITHOUT numerical statistics or percentages), and weave in 20% (up to 2 overlapping competency phrases) aligned with the target Job Description.' WHERE id = 667 OR (section_name = 'summary' AND rule_instruction ILIKE '%80% Existing Experience%'); UPDATE role_few_shot_library SET sample_summary_html = '

Senior Data & Business Analyst combining extensive enterprise data analytics and operations intelligence experience with a strong foundation in commercial strategy and stakeholder consulting. Proven track record of architecting automated data pipelines and interactive KPI reporting suites using SQL, Python, and Tableau to uncover operational bottlenecks and elevate cross-functional delivery quality. Adept at applying data cleaning and transformation and diagnostic root-cause analysis to translate complex datasets into clear executive presentations and actionable business decisions.

' WHERE sample_summary_html ~ '[0-9]+%|1M\+|15\+|5\+'; UPDATE resume_generations SET summary_html = CASE WHEN position_title ~* 'product|growth|funnel|experiment|retention|marketing' THEN '

Senior Data & Business Analyst combining extensive enterprise data analytics and operations intelligence experience with a strong foundation in commercial strategy and stakeholder consulting. Proven track record of applying SQL, Python, and Tableau across product, growth, and commercial datasets to uncover conversion bottlenecks, automate recurring performance reporting, and guide customer acquisition and retention strategy. Adept at applying funnel and cohort segmentation and diagnostic root-cause analysis to translate complex datasets into clear executive presentations and actionable business decisions.

' WHEN position_title ~* 'financ|fp&a|risk|treasury|payment|commercial|pricing|revenue|monetiz' THEN '

Senior Data & Business Analyst combining extensive enterprise data analytics and operations intelligence experience with a strong foundation in commercial strategy and stakeholder consulting. Proven track record of leveraging SQL, Python, and Tableau for financial reconciliation, commercial pricing analysis, and automated KPI governance across enterprise and regional operations. Adept at applying data cleaning and transformation and automated dashboard reporting to translate complex datasets into clear executive presentations and actionable business decisions.

' WHEN position_title ~* 'operations|strategy|consulting|workforce|process|program|business analyst' THEN '

Senior Data & Business Analyst combining extensive enterprise data analytics and operations intelligence experience with a strong foundation in commercial strategy and stakeholder consulting. Proven track record of utilizing SQL, Python, and Tableau to diagnose operational SLA bottlenecks, standardize cross-functional workflows, and scale process efficiency across global teams. Adept at applying workflow automation and QA governance and narrative insight synthesis to translate complex datasets into clear executive presentations and actionable business decisions.

' ELSE '

Senior Data & Business Analyst combining extensive enterprise data analytics and operations intelligence experience with a strong foundation in commercial strategy and stakeholder consulting. Proven track record of architecting automated data pipelines and interactive KPI reporting suites using SQL, Python, and Tableau to streamline reporting workflows, resolve operational bottlenecks, and elevate cross-functional delivery quality. Adept at applying data cleaning and transformation and diagnostic root-cause analysis to translate complex datasets into clear executive presentations and actionable business decisions.

' END WHERE summary_html ~ '[0-9]+%|1M\+|15\+|5\+'; UPDATE workflow_entity SET "parentFolderId" = 'vC7m13ZLDvyrB9M5' WHERE (name ILIKE '%CareerPulse%' OR id IN ('iMfs7ePJT5NNaPbW','OH96b2tHgFWXoEJ6','lXNGL9OcyVVtCBuz','T4k9rXZ2CKK72xZS','kYpYvF2pM66RYXCC','rdkSBj2Xmk5rA05e','QL9218oxuBxpYefQ','DK7BGr5CVZrkPe6W')) AND ("parentFolderId" IS NULL OR "parentFolderId" <> 'vC7m13ZLDvyrB9M5'); SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(session_cookies, ''), NULLIF(encrypted_password, '')) FROM portal_credentials_vault WHERE site_name IN ('LinkedIn_Session_Cookie', 'SSO_Master_LinkedIn', 'LinkedIn Jobs') AND LENGTH(COALESCE(NULLIF(session_cookies, ''), NULLIF(encrypted_password, ''), '')) > 15 LIMIT 1) AS li_at_cookie, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(rg)), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT * FROM resume_generations ORDER BY CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(s_no, resume_id, '0'), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS INT) ASC NULLS LAST ) rg) AS resume_gens, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(cg)), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT * FROM cover_letter_generations ORDER BY updated_at DESC ) cg) AS cl_gens, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(lr)), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT id, section_name, role_category, rule_instruction, triggered_by_comment, created_at FROM learned_rules WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY id DESC ) lr) AS all_learned_rules, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(ll)), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT * FROM linkedin_activity_log ORDER BY CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(activity_id, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS INT) DESC NULLS LAST ) ll) AS li_logs, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(fc)), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT * FROM linkedin_network_contacts ORDER BY CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(contact_id, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS INT) DESC NULLS LAST ) fc) AS fh_contacts, (SELECT row_to_json(ls) FROM ( SELECT * FROM linkedin_daily_stats WHERE stat_date = CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 1 ) ls) AS li_stats, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(v)), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT site_name, portal_url, profile_review_url, login_method, auth_email, communication_email, username, auth_status, profile_approval_status, custom_preferences_note, updated_at FROM portal_credentials_vault WHERE site_name NOT IN ('Gmail_008_IMAP_SMTP', 'SSO_Master_LinkedIn', 'SSO_Master_GitHub', 'CareerPulse_Web_Session', 'LinkedIn_Session_Cookie') ORDER BY site_name ASC ) v) AS vault_rows, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(s)), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT site_name, portal_url, login_method, auth_email, auth_status, CASE WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(session_cookies, '')) > 15 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_cookie, updated_at FROM portal_credentials_vault WHERE site_name IN ('SSO_Master_LinkedIn', 'SSO_Master_GitHub') ) s) AS social_sso_rows, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(l)), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT * FROM portal_apply_limits ORDER BY site_name ASC ) l) AS limit_rows, (SELECT row_to_json(ws) FROM (SELECT auth_email, auth_status, custom_preferences_note, updated_at FROM portal_credentials_vault WHERE site_name = 'CareerPulse_Web_Session' LIMIT 1) ws) AS web_session, (SELECT row_to_json(m) FROM master_resume_state m WHERE id = 1) AS master_resume, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(rc)), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT * FROM reference_contacts_cache ORDER BY company_name ASC ) rc) AS ref_contacts, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(ea)), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT * FROM job_hunter_email_alerts ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 15 ) ea) AS email_alerts;
